analyst.summary: Yatharth Hospital continues to post strong, consistent growth - revenue up in the mid-20s percent and profit up faster, aided by hospitals maturing into higher-value specialty care rather than just adding beds. This is one of the more genuine growth stories in this review, with three-year and one-year growth trends closely aligned rather than showing a one-off spike. The stock's valuation already reflects much of this strength, and the company remains smaller and more geographically concentrated (Delhi-NCR) than the larger hospital chains, which caps how much further re-rating room may exist.
